'''Bolt''' was a person who worked as a bartender at [[The Chasm]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Gadrin]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. After the cantina was attacked by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Raik Muun]], the [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] [[Forg F'lopo|Forg F'Lopo]] was caught up in the furor. Bolt said that F'Lopo could have some free drinks at the cantina the next day, to help get over it.
